name: SPT-CL J0442-6138 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0442-6138, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj04426138-webb
story: A crowd of galaxies bound together by gravity, one of 182 massive clusters Webb imaged to learn how a cluster's central galaxy and its diffuse haze of stars build up, and how dark matter spreads through it.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0442-6138 is a cluster-of-galaxies target in Webb program 5594
Webb program 5594 images 182 massive galaxy clusters
The program studies how the central galaxy and intracluster light build up, and how dark matter is distributed in the clusters
